note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Disturbing unknown material risks releasing fibres. The stop-work notification and assessment come first.
WorkSafe Victoria's bushfire guidance names the Class A (friable) licence for friable clean-up. Class B covers non-friable material. The question is Victorian only.

practicalCriteria: The learner recognises asbestos-suspect material from the building's age and the fire damage, and stops work.
The learner does not disturb suspect material and does not propose do-it-yourself clean-up.
The learner identifies the competent assessment that is still missing.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Asbestos is found or suspected during clean-up.
Ceiling sheeting or insulation of unknown composition would be disturbed.
